hooks.name: guard-golden
hooks.description: Block writes to golden files, fixtures and recordings unless the user approved the exact change

hooks.name: review-integrity
hooks.description: A review report may be written only while the main worktree is unchanged since the review baseline

hooks.name: guard-shell
hooks.description: Block git push and destructive git, GitHub write operations, credential exposure, provider calls, and project test or run commands outside the approved network-isolation wrapper

hooks.name: fmt-check
hooks.description: Report rustfmt differences in a Rust file after it is written; never rewrites

hooks.name: stop-report
hooks.description: Report working-tree state, flag golden, catalogue and architecture changes, run the relevant architecture checks
